experiments.experiment_label: αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR transduction of liver macrophages and functional evaluation in liver fibrosis
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: In this study, we explored a pioneering therapeutic approach leveraging CD163 antibody-conjugated liposomal nanoparticles (LNPs) encapsulating FAP-specific chimeric antigen receptor macrophage (CAR-M) mRNA (αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR).
experiments.payload_or_treatment_mention: FAP-specific chimeric antigen receptor macrophage (CAR-M) mRNA
experiments.therapeutic_target_mention: FAP (Fibroblast activation protein), expressed by activated HSCs
experiments.distinctness_reason: This is the sole original experimental intervention described, involving a specific LNP formulation, payload, recipient cell, and disease context. No other experiment with materially differing parameters is reported.
